title: Unit 5 Consolidation: colonial society
goal: Review how the empire was governed, the hierarchy of groups, the Church, daily life in the city and how colonial society changed.

items: Talk about colonial society with the passive with *se*, relative clauses with a preposition, *para que*, frequency adverbs and verbs of change.
Put the creation of the viceroyalties in order.
Name the groups of colonial society and the institutions of the empire.
Use the words of the unit: viceroy, criollo, mission, cabildo and plaza.
Say what the Church, the plaza and the markets were in colonial life.
